advisor.role: Completed source/theory advice; contracts mechanically assembled from host-provided approved definition

claim_ceiling: Conditional delivered-observable research only; no native solver/ODE, physical foreground law, cosmological p, posterior, or original acceptance promotion.
goal: Test whether two frequency-anchor E tensors predict heldout B coordinates of other delivered native-resolution frequency differences

sources.scope: Planck III section3.1.4 PSB choice and section3.3 uncertainty
Extra70GHz gain template in SMICA preprocessing
Official map2alm_spin API; native spin projection

smica_full.source: Advisor freshly hashed existing cached full-mission map; verify at execution
smica_full.use: Reproject under the newly specified operator; never substitute inherited60views

common_mask.rule: Keep selected NSIDE64 cell iff ALL native children Q/U in all seven frequency maps plus SMICA full are valid and finite
common_mask.selection: Sentinel/finite validity only; no amplitude-based selection
common_mask.record: Retained and removed cell identities/counts and reason; exact common support used for all products
common_mask.native_expansion: Lift retained64cells to each native NSIDE without changing Q/U

projection.operator: Native-NSIDE map2alm_spin([M Q,M U],spin=2,lmax=3,mmax=3), uniform pixel quadrature
projection.resolution: Actual native NSIDE1024/2048; no silent resolution lowering
projection.preprocessing: Do not apply existing SMICA weights to these maps as though their preprocessing matched;70GHz gain-template requirement remains explicit
retained_in_operator: spin operator and E/B mask mixing
projection.unit_normalization: Treat LFI K_CMB and HFI Kcmb as same thermodynamic temperature units; retain raw FITS unit/convention keywords

bound_raw_STF_decoder_input.requirement: Convert canonical orthonormal real coordinates back to raw Re/Im before calling the bound raw-STF decoder

independent_basis_fixture.input: Raw harmonic a_21=i, other ell2 coefficients zero
independent_basis_fixture.test_rule: Verify independently against analytic basis, not only a round trip

frozen_crossprediction.fit: For each target, fit c using E-only least squares A_E c≈d_nu,E
frozen_crossprediction.prediction: Predict d_nu,B with A_B c without refitting B
frozen_crossprediction.condition_requirement: s2/s1>1e-8 is a descriptive conditioning screen only; it alone never licenses exact-relation rejection
frozen_crossprediction.ill_conditioned_status: ANCHOR_FIT_ILL_CONDITIONED; retain full carrier/singular values, no unstable prediction
frozen_crossprediction.logical_interpretation: Full E rank gives unique exact E coefficients. Exact delivered-tensor relation rejection additionally requires deterministic error certification and a B residual exceeding the certified necessary bound. Without certification report full descriptive residuals and NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED; never infer physical component count.
frozen_crossprediction.B_heldout_status: Heldout coordinates, not an independent observational sample

definitions.eps_AE: Certified spectral-norm error upper bound for AE, K_CMB
definitions.eps_yE: Certified Euclidean error upper bound for yE, K_CMB
definitions.eps_AB: Certified spectral-norm error upper bound for AB, K_CMB
definitions.eps_yB: Certified Euclidean error upper bound for yB, K_CMB
definitions.s: Certified positive lower bound s<=sigma_min(AE), K_CMB
definitions.AB_norm_upper: Certified upper bound on spectral ||AB||, K_CMB
definitions.B_residual_roundoff: Certified residual-evaluation roundoff upper bound, K_CMB

deterministic_error_certification.unresolved_if: s<=eps_AE, or any required deterministic error/norm/residual certification unavailable
deterministic_error_certification.rejection_rule: Only an observed B residual with a certified lower bound greater than tau_B disproves the exact delivered-tensor relation under these deterministic bounds. Preserve all bounds and arithmetic provenance.
deterministic_error_certification.absence_of_certificate: Report descriptive full residuals and NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED exact relation; no rejection
deterministic_error_certification.independent_implementations: Agreement between implementations does not certify either implementation error

conditioning_counterexample.construction: AE=[a*u,a*(u+1e-7*v)], AB=[a*p,a*q]; u/v and p/q orthonormal; exact target is anchor2
conditioning_counterexample.lesson: Singular ratio screen and fixed absolute agreement tolerance can pass while conditioning amplifies E error into large B residual

resources.timeout: Preserve finished product results and actual receipt; no silent resolution lowering
resources.fits: memmap; chunk NESTED-to-RING into two float64 Q/U arrays; do not retain seven maps simultaneously

controls: Pure E and pure B all basis vectors and fixed mixtures
Linearity, sign, harmonic order and convention
Independent explicit low-order spin-harmonic discrete sums on real products, atol1e-12 K_CMB rtol1e-9
Independent analytic a21=i raw-STF basis fixture with Qyz=+sqrt(15/(8*pi)); detect direct-canonical error -sqrt(15/(4*pi))
Conditioning amplification counterexample and required NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED outcome when no deterministic error certificate exists
lower_resolution_comparison: If separately approved, label as approximation only; never replace frozen native-resolution result

functional_bundle.x: Retain all168 frequency coordinates and24 freshly reprojected SMICA coordinates with full STF carriers
functional_bundle.Q: Computational gauges only; physical MES unavailable
functional_bundle.F: If a finite frequency-index count is used, explicitly specify seven-point measure; not a physical mixture law

uncertainty: FITS QQ/QU/UU are not a matched joint low-ell law; no cosmological p, posterior or physical foreground bound
next_decision: Actual residual tensors determine whether matched gain-template, beam or end-to-end simulation acquisition is the next discriminating action; never claim all methods complete.
